item.title: 14" Length Mini Cargo Skirts-(Blue)
item.description:
Feel the comfort and style of pure cotton denim fabric. This utility-inspired denim skirt is full of charm, with multiple pockets adding functionality. The high-waisted Y2K mini skirt radiates both cute and playful charm while showcasing the distinctive vibe. The Size XS- 0-2 S- 4-6 M- 8-10 L- 12-14 XL- 16-18 100% Cotton Button Fly Leather label on the back Multi-pocket Hand wash/Machine wash

14" Length Mini Cargo Skirts-(Blue) is developed for international brands, importers, retailers, distributors and promotional buyers. Final material, dimensions, color, decoration and packing are confirmed for each order.
